title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/044 (comparative): bedroom natural light, G7/AS1 scope in proposed townhouses
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; G7/AS1 referenced (edition not stated in extracted text)

facts.text: The matter is whether bedroom 3 in units 2-6 of the proposed multi-unit building is within the scope of Acceptable Solution G7/AS1.
The proposed building is a three-storey residential building with seven attached townhouse units.
Each unit has a garage and laundry on the ground floor, three bedrooms and two bathrooms on the first floor, and kitchen and living areas on the second floor.
The end units have additional windows installed in their external end walls.
The authority raised the location and characteristics of a taller neighbouring building on the boundary.
